scope: Selected static-calibrated ModelOpt FP8 Linear roles in artifacts7/17/28 only; no model scope expansion, payload, build, GPU or performance run.

facts.configured_output_default: All three saved model configs are BF16; local deployment Linear preserves activation dtype. This is a default model path, not a claim that safetensors specifies GEMM output dtype.
facts.storage: Observed true FP8 Linear weights are plain F8_E4M3[N,K], with one independent F32 weight_scale and input_scale per original role. Q27/GLM use rank0 scalars; sampled Q24 uses[1]. No block128/F32 attached scale layout or per-token computed scale is indicated by these inspected roles.

examples.note: Three fields lie in different sampled shards140/181/184.

important_exclusions: F8_E4M3 weight_scale for U8 NVFP4 weights is not an FP8 weight role.
Sample Q24 shard200 is207 BF16 MTP tensors, zeroFP8; retained as a negative observation, not treated as static FP8 evidence.
Static FP8 KV and conv1d targets are not established by these Linear headers.
No scale numeric value, finite/positive bound, equality, clipping incidence or gapped physical payload was inferred from metadata.

scale_export.formula: F32 exported scaling_factor = F32(export_amax / maxbound448); positive assertion appears in helper. W exporter emits float8_e4m3fn(weight / weight_scale); exporter source uses plain per-tensor or per-channel branches, but inspected actual roles have only scalar scales.
scale_export.limits: Stored input_scale alone cannot reconstruct the exact pre-export calibrated amax, nor the original scale=448/amax and its reciprocal rounding pair. Tensor promotion/output of weight/scale division depends on the source tensor rank/dtype; do not retroactively re-encode stored W to mimic it.

calibration_fake_QDQ.normal_case: Cast source to F32; compute scale=F32(448/amax), normalize F32(x*scale), convert E4M3, widen to F32, multiply by F32(1/scale), return original dtype(BF16 in these configs). This is fake QDQ for original normal Linear, not serialized-code GEMM.
calibration_fake_QDQ.0.42_difference: 0.42 eager code has no explicit clamp or tiny-amax replacement; CUDA extension uses __nv_fp8_e4m3 constructor SATFINITE and F32 multiply/dequant. Eager/special/out-of-range equivalence is not established.
calibration_fake_QDQ.913f_difference: 913f eager adds amax<=2^-24 ->safe_amax1 and explicit[-448,448] clamp; CUDA extension has same tiny-amax replacement and saturating FP8 constructor. NaN and all zero edge domains need an explicit chosen public policy.
calibration_fake_QDQ.RNE_evidence: CUDA __nv_fp8_e4m3 constructor delegates to __nv_cvt_float_to_fp8 with __NV_SATFINITE; standard conversion is nearest-even. No compilation/execution of the exporter kernel was performed.

deployment_contract.activation: For supplied scalar input_scale: load A as F32, compute reciprocal1/SA, multiply, clamp to FP8 bounds, cast E4M3. No row absmax, epsilon floor, block128 or token recomputation. The Triton source tree is established; actual PTX reciprocal precision is not signed here.
deployment_contract.weight: Keep existing serialized FP8 codes. Cold transpose[N,K] to a logical[K,N] column-major view can be metadata-only; fused logical projections may requantize to max scale during consumer loading, which is an explicit numerical operation, not free aliasing.
deployment_contract.dot_output: Deployment per-tensor path passes quantized A/W and separate SA/SW to torch._scaled_mm, out_dtype=input_dtype(BF16 here). Generic fallback explicitly obtains F32 raw code dot then F32 output*SA*SW, adds optional bias, and finally casts to input dtype. Native GEMM exact accumulation/scale epilogue and CUTLASS paths are implementation-specific and not measured/proved identical by this research.
deployment_contract.fast_accum: Pinned installed Torch2.8 header declares use_fast_accum=false by default; SGLang per-tensor call omits this flag. This is API selection, not a proof of every TensorCore intermediate sum or kernel.
different_paths: ModelOpt from_quantized_weight converts both codes and scale to target dtype before multiplication, so its BF16 fallback is another explicit rounding tree.
SGLang Marlin FP8 weight-only branch deletes input_scale and leaves A unquantized; it is W8A16 and cannot witness W8A8 calibrated activation support.
BF16 fake-QDQ operands, code-domain F32 dot+scales and hardware scaled_mm cannot be declared equal merely because all sayFP8.

existing_semantics: DataType::kFloat8E4M3FN plain storage, Cast, Binary reciprocal/divide/multiply, min/max, transpose View, F32 MatMul and final Cast can express an explicit static software reference.
Existing Float8BlockLinear/GroupedFloat8Linear choose dynamic block128 activations and attached scales; they are different operations.
Existing CT channel/token fixture is BF16 per-token QDQ with BF16 channel SW, a zero-only epsilon and operand dequant before dot; it is not this artifact contract.
actual_gaps: No currently declared calibrated static FP8 code-dot/scale recipe or bounded native region for these plain codes+scalar scales.

Ordinary MatMul output has the operand dtype; raw FP8 MatMul cannot simply request BF16 output by setting accumulation_type. Explicit F32 code widening/dot/scales/final Cast expresses the intended reference instead.

Apple logical raw E4M3 bridge is explicitly admitted only to typed NVFP4 consumers (apple_operations.cc:365-375); generic FP8 Cast cannot be presumed supported there. Vulkan generic scalar carrier likewise has no demonstrated plain FP8 Cast path.

HYLE elementwise min/max have fmin/fmax one-NaN semantics; upstream clamp NaN propagation is different. A generic min/max chain needs an explicit NaN-preserving selection, or a stated validated input domain, before claiming full special-value parity.

minimal_next_package.recommendation: First declare one ordinary Graph software-reference code-domain recipe in the shared fixture; no new public storage ID/ArtifactWeightDecode enum or static-mode extension to dynamic Float8BlockLinear. Supply bounded cold native contraction/lowering of that exact recipe, preserving the public graph.
four_external_ports: A BF16[M,K] (or later explicitly selected F16/F32)
SA F32 scalar, accepting rank0/[1] canonical scalar forms
SW F32 scalar, independent of SA
minimal_next_package.exact_chosen_reference_needed_before_imp: Select and document normalize F32(A)*F32(1/SA) -> NaN-preserving clamp448 -> E4M3RNE; F32 code dot; separate F32 multiply by SA thenSW; final BF16RNE. This is stored-scale software reference, not bitwise recreation of unavailable calibrated amax or native scaled_mm. Preserve signed zeros/NaN class and full positive finite scale domain including subnormal if accepted; do not silently precombine SA*SW.
minimal_next_package.ordinary_graph: Cast A toF32 -> reciprocal SA/multiply -> explicit clamp+FP8 Cast -> CastF32; Cast W toF32 -> exact transpose; MatMul(accumF32) -> Mul SA -> Mul SW -> CastBF16. Keep quantized code values and rounding nodes visible.
minimal_next_package.bounded_lowering: One private prepared composite of the exact closed graph can store MK FP8 activation bytes and bounded W tiles, retain original immutable NK FP8 bank/scalars and own perInvocation status/workspace. No dense N*K float array, newexecutor or globalcache. Escaping published intermediates retain the original decomposition.
minimal_next_package.when_public_typed_op_is_justified: A future general scaled MatMul taking FP8 operands with independently declared output dtype/scales is a genuine typed behavior missing from MatMul. It is not required merely to express the software graph; introduce it only if selected as a stable public mathematical contract, not as an artifact-name shortcut.
bounded_tests: Small non-square geometry plus actual-role descriptor[N128,K8192] or[N10240,K5120] without large payload; normal finite scales and positive/negative E4M3 codes.

Independent scalar activation ties/clipping/signedzero, BF16-QDQ-vs-code-dot witness, separate scale-order overflow witness, zero/NaN/Inf scale rejection or explicit documented behavior; actual numeric artifact values remain unread.
Two slots, in-place dynamic A/SA/SW updates, immutable original W owner and retained output lifetime; published intermediate fallback.
Existing dynamic block128 and CT channel/token paths remain separate neighbors. No whole-model or throughput claim in this package.

deepinfer_layout_lesson.bounded_application: These actual Linear roles have scalar F32 scales and plain row-major[N,K] FP8 codes. Do not copy DeepInfer block32/UE8M0 swizzles or scale padding. Bind original immutable code bank once, use zero-copy transpose where accepted, and emit activation code bytes directly into the selected consumer layout only after the BF16/F32 normalization contract is explicit.
deepinfer_layout_lesson.later_revisit: After this static reference is numerically and lifetime-complete, inspect one real supported norm/projection producer to remove intermediate representation writes. No capture/config/pool redesign or currentBF16Qwen performance claim.

observation_phase: Research performed before product implementation; current implementation progress belongs to current-work.md and later correctness receipts.
chosen_ordinary_reference: F32(A) * F32(1/SA), then existing SATFINITE E4M3FN storage Cast (equivalent to NaN-preserving clamp448 followed by RNE), widen codes toF32, F32 code-dot, multiply SA thenSW separately, final declared floating Cast. Literal1 is a typed Fill with the same scalar shape as SA, not an external artifact port.
